mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username} AND status='active'

SELECT COUNT(*) total_runs, COALESCE(SUM(status='SUCCEEDED'), 0) succeeded_runs, COALESCE(SUM(status='FAILED'), 0) failed_runs, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) average_duration_ms FROM ai_agent_run WHERE run_type='ONLINE' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) total_tool_calls, COALESCE(SUM(success=0), 0) failed_tool_calls FROM ai_agent_tool_call c JOIN ai_agent_run r ON r.run_id=c.run_id WHERE r.run_type='ONLINE' AND c.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) feedback_total, COALESCE(SUM(rating='UP'), 0) positive_feedback, COALESCE(SUM(rating='DOWN'), 0) negative_feedback FROM ai_agent_feedback WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT case_id, case_name, question, page_context, expected_tool_name, expected_keywords, enabled, creator_username, create_time FROM ai_agent_evaluation_case ORDER BY case_id DESC
SELECT case_id, case_name, question, page_context, expected_tool_name, expected_keywords, enabled, creator_username, create_time FROM ai_agent_evaluation_case WHERE case_id=#{caseId}

SELECT r.result_id, r.case_id, c.case_name, r.agent_run_id, r.model, r.actual_tools, r.expected_tool_matched, r.expected_keywords_matched, r.passed, r.detail, r.duration_ms, r.evaluator_username, r.create_time FROM ai_agent_evaluation_result r JOIN ai_agent_evaluation_case c ON c.case_id=r.case_id ORDER BY r.result_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_evaluation_case (case_name, question, page_context, expected_tool_name, expected_keywords, creator_id, creator_username) VALUES (#{caseName}, #{question}, #{pageContext}, #{expectedToolName}, #{expectedKeywords}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorUsername})

INSERT INTO ai_agent_evaluation_result (case_id, agent_run_id, model, actual_tools, expected_tool_matched, expected_keywords_matched, passed, detail, duration_ms, evaluator_username) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{agentRunId}, #{model}, #{actualTools}, #{expectedToolMatched}, #{expectedKeywordsMatched}, #{passed}, #{detail}, #{durationMs}, #{evaluatorUsername})
